evidence.notes: SOQL test stubs dispatch real query text, target SObjectType, and bind values to the provider callback.

source.content: public class SoqlStubProviderCallbackProvider implements SoqlStubProvider { public List<SObject> handleSoqlQuery(Schema.SObjectType targetType, String query, Map<String,Object> binds) { Boolean queryOk = query != null && query.length() > 0; String name = String.valueOf(targetType) + ':' + String.valueOf(queryOk) + ':' + String.valueOf(binds.get('name')); return Test.createStubQueryRows(targetType, new List<Map<String,Object>>{new Map<String,Object>{'Name' => name}}); } public Object clone() { return this; } }

@isTest private class SoqlStubProviderCallbackTest { @isTest static void callbackReceivesQueryShape() { Test.createSoqlStub(Account.SObjectType, new SoqlStubProviderCallbackProvider()); String name = 'Acme'; List<Account> rows = Database.queryWithBinds('SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE Name = :name', new Map<String,Object>{'name' => name}); System.assertEquals(1, rows.size()); System.assert(rows[0].Name.startsWith('Account:')); System.assert(rows[0].Name.contains(':true:')); System.assert(rows[0].Name.endsWith(':Acme')); } }
